name: Refinishing Rental Hardwood Between Tenants in Renton
title-tag: Refinishing Rental Hardwood Between Tenants | Renton, WA
meta-description: The between-tenants playbook for Renton rentals: recoat at $1.99/sq ft on a cadence, refinish at $3.99 when wear hits wood, and fit it all inside one turnover.
post-summary: December 21, 2026 · An empty unit is the cheapest, cleanest refinishing window a landlord gets — no furniture charges, no household to work around. The turnover ladder ($1.99 recoats on a cadence, $3.99 refinish when wear reaches wood), the tenant-proof spec, and the timeline math for Renton's Boeing-era rentals.
